heading: About the Designer
name: Alexandra MacColl
headshotAlt: Portrait of fashion designer Alexandra MacColl
paragraphs: Alexandra is an emerging Australian fashion designer based in Sydney, currently completing a Bachelor of Design in Fashion and Textiles alongside a Diploma of Innovation at the University of Technology Sydney.

Her design practice centres on contemporary menswear, exploring the relationship between clothing, the body and identity through experimental patternmaking, unconventional silhouettes and textile surface print. Informed by historical dress, material research and cultural references, her work challenges conventional representations of the dressed body through a combination of conceptual investigation, collage and practical garment development.

Working across garment construction, screen printing and textile experimentation, she is interested in the capacity of clothing to transform physical form and communicate ideas beyond functionality. Her approach brings together research, visual expression and material exploration, with a particular interest in the intersection of contemporary menswear, humour and the grotesque. Through her graduate collection, The Constructed Man, she investigates the construction of masculine identity through exaggerated proportions and the manipulation of the male silhouette.
